column1: # UDG-003 H1 — every retained evidence bundle verified by the verifier built from its OWN capture commit.
# Run 2026-11-13 against /workspace/udg-evidence. 151 bundles over 66 capture commits. Read-only on the store.
# Method: git worktree at the bundle implementationSha (outside the repository root, see F-2), pnpm install --frozen-lockfile,
#   pnpm --dir tools/checks build, then node tools/checks/dist/evidence.js verify --run <bundle>.
# verifierVerdict is the gate's opinion of the BYTES against the capture plan of that commit.
# capturedRunStatus is what the CI run itself wrote into report.json. They are different claims: a bundle can verify
#   PASS as bytes while its run was red (the retained counterexamples), and one early bundle verifies PASS because the
#   check that refuses a red captured gate (EVIDENCE-GATE-NOT-PASS) did not exist at its commit (24cc93bd).
